name: 0x Swap API

limitations.detail: Auth is 0x-api-key header; a second required header 0x-version: v2 exists and is not expressible in the single-header template

No OHLCV/candle endpoint exists; candles path mapped to documented indicative-price endpoint, which returns a single quote object (raw-integer buyAmount/sellAmount, no ts/open/high/low/close/volume fields) â {tf}/{from}/{to}/{limit} params do not exist

No token/market listing endpoint documented; /swap/v1/sources (legacy v1, sunset 2025-04-11) lists liquidity sources only and its response schema is undocumented â 0x demo apps fetch token lists from CoinGecko
Instruments are (chainId, token contract address) pairs passed as sellToken/buyToken; symbol-based symbol_format is not applicable

Quote-only execution: /swap/allowance-holder/quote returns an unsigned on-chain transaction to submit via a web3 library (AllowanceHolder/Permit2 allowance flow); no REST order placement, no market/limit orders, no order book/depth endpoint
Spot DEX aggregation only (373+ liquidity sources, 20+ chains); no margin/futures/perpetual API â margin=null and no margin_style classifiable
fee_pct not documented â fees are dynamic (zeroExFee volume-based, optional integratorFee, gasFee); using conservative default 0.2
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
price_band_pct not documented â slippage is configured per quote, no price band; using default 5.0
qty_step not documented â amounts are raw token decimals (18 for WETH, 6 for USDC); using default 8
min_collateral_usdt/max_collateral_usdt/max_risk_coef/interest_per_4h_pct not documented â no margin trading exists; defaults kept
min_gap_sec not stated (Rate Limits page values absent from corpus) â using conservative default 1.0
Full OpenAPI specs (openapi/evm-apis.json, openapi/solana-swap-apis.json, openapi/cross-chain-apis.json) were not included in the provided corpus

0x is a DEX aggregator, not an order-book exchange: trading is done via /swap/allowance-holder/quote returning an unsigned EVM transaction submitted on-chain. No candles, ticker, or depth endpoints exist; candles.path is mapped to the documented /price endpoint which returns a spot quote (buyAmount/sellAmount), not OHLCV.

/swap/allowance-holder/price returns a quote object (buyToken, sellToken, buyAmount, sellAmount, minBuyAmount, fees, route) â no ts/open/high/low/close/volume fields, so field_map omitted. Tokens are identified by contract addresses (sellToken/buyToken params), not symbols.

No v2 markets/token-list endpoint documented; /swap/v1/sources (v1) lists liquidity sources per chain, not tradable pairs, and v1 was sunset 2025-04-11 per 0x migration notice. openapi.json is only an index of three spec files (evm, solana, cross-chain) without inline schemas.
All calls require '0x-api-key' header plus required '0x-version: v2' header; requests also need chainId and taker address parameters. This is a plain API key, not an exchange account auth.

min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0. Fees: response contains zeroExFee with type 'volume' but no fixed percent is stated â using default fee_pct 0.2; gas fees apply per trade (totalNetworkFee).

No margin trading API â margin=null; min/max_collateral_usdt, max_risk_coef, interest_per_4h_pct not applicable, kept at defaults. qty_step not documented: token amounts use per-token decimals (e.g. WETH 18) in base units â default 8 kept.
price_band_pct=0: no price band stated; slippage is controlled via quote parameters and minBuyAmount. Rate Limits page exists but no numeric values in docs â min_gap_sec default 1.0.
Spot DEX aggregation only (Swap API, Gasless API, Cross-Chain API); no margin, leverage, or perpetuals/funding model documented, so no margin_style.
